content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Roadway maintenance, vegetation and agricultural equipment; no overlap with HVAC or refrigeration equipment."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Ceiling and wall building products for construction; not heating, cooling or refrigeration equipment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and brake components; different products and customers from HVAC equipment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Mainly roof coatings, adhesives and industrial valves; HVAC is only one segment of a diversified mix."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributor of plumbing, waterworks and HVAC products to contractors, not a manufacturer of heating and cooling equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Pool and spa pumps, filters and heaters sold to pool builders and owners; different end market and products."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Refrigerant sales and reclamation services; a service and chemicals model rather than equipment manufacturing."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber products; building materials rather than HVAC equipment."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Structural connectors, anchors and fasteners for wood and concrete construction; not HVAC equipment."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Designs and manufactures HVAC equipment for buildings, sold to contractors and building owners, like Lennox; also has unrelated lines."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Turf maintenance, lawn mowers and snow throwers; outdoor power equipment rather than building HVAC."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Commercial plumbing fixtures, water coolers and filtration; water products, not heating or cooling equipment."}]}
